4. 3. 4. 2. 

(Paṭibhānapuggalasuttaṃ)

32. cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. Katame cattāro?

Yuttapaṭibhāno. Na muttapaṭibhāno, muttapaṭibhāno na yuttapaṭibhāno, yuttapaṭibhāno ca muttapaṭibhāno ca, neva yuttapaṭibhāno neva muttapaṭibhāno. 

Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
